stocks.title: Earnings week starts Monday: NFLX Tuesday, then TSLA, META and IBM Wednesday after the close
stocks.detail: After the worst Nasdaq 100 week since April 2025, traders see this slate as the real test. GM and GE Aerospace report Tuesday, P&G and AmEx later, plus claims and PMIs. Guidance on AI spend and consumer demand sets QQQ's tone.

stocks.title: Semis just logged a nine-session losing streak, the longest in two decades
stocks.detail: Per X recaps, SOXX fell about 14% over nine straight days and over 11% on the week, with only 3.3% of members above their 10-day average. Bulls see a washout rebound; bears cite AI financing worries and China memory competition.

stocks.title: Black Monday turns 39 on Monday, and traders noticed the calendar lines up
stocks.detail: Oct 19, 1987 also fell on a Monday, when the Dow dropped 22.6%. Most posts are superstition and jokes, but record margin debt and this week's volatility keep the date on traders' minds for the open.

stocks.title: Schwab rolls out bitcoin and ether trading as BTC holds near 81.5K
stocks.detail: Schwab finished the rollout on its site, app and thinkorswim, with more coins planned by year-end. Bitcoin is still pinned in the 81K to 83K range despite Friday's spot ETF outflows, the only live risk tape until Sunday night.

tech.title: Tesla's thruster Roadster demo is still the loudest car debate on X
tech.detail: The next-gen Roadster flipped and hopped on cold-gas thrusters at a SpaceX site in Texas. X is split on showmanship vs engineering and road legality; production is targeted for 2028. It's buzz heading into TSLA earnings Wednesday.

tech.title: Musk: Optimus will build Optimus Prime
tech.detail: Musk's Transformers-themed post landed as posts say Tesla is building Optimus robots in the hundreds per week at Fremont, aiming for over 1,000 by year-end. Expect robot questions on Wednesday's TSLA call.

tech.title: Anthropic's Jack Clark lays out an extreme AI growth case at the IMF meetings
tech.detail: In Bangkok, Clark said Anthropic's models show US GDP reaching 44 trillion by 2030 in an extreme fast-AI scenario, a figure he called outlandish but grounded. He also pushed for stronger global rules as markets question AI spending.

tech.title: Bluesky gets backlash for launching Attie, an AI vibe-coding tool
tech.detail: Attie lets users build mini games and quizzes without code. Artists who left X to dodge AI training feel betrayed, and critics noted Bluesky announced it on X. A sign of how polarizing AI features still are with users.

world.title: More supertanker explosions in Hormuz as CENTCOM insists the strait is open
world.detail: One tanker hit a mine and burned; another was disabled. CENTCOM says about 400 merchant ships transited last week, but independent data shows traffic roughly 70% below normal. Any weekend escalation hits oil and the Sunday futures open.

world.title: Trump urges Saudi Arabia to accept Israel's help against the Houthis
world.detail: He said the kingdom should take Israel's offer as the Houthis target Saudi oil sites and airports, and hinted Saudi-Israel normalization talks could resume. Red Sea shipping and energy supply are the market angle.

world.title: Lakers wrap preseason with a 121-106 loss to Denver and shop Dalton Knecht
world.detail: Reaves led LA with 19 as Murray and Jokic paced the Nuggets. The Lakers have talked Knecht with the Bucks, Bulls and Jazz ahead of the Oct 19 roster cutdown. The regular season tips off Tuesday.

world.title: Michigan hosts Penn State at 3:30 PM ET, both chasing a first Big Ten win
world.detail: The Wolverines are 6.5-point favorites coming off a bye, with Bryce Underwood under center. Penn State is 0-3 in conference under first-year coach Matt Campbell. Oregon starts walk-on QB Brock Thomas vs Nebraska tonight.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: Chiefs tomorrow, Lakers tip Tuesday, TSLA reports Wednesday. Big week, Kent. Let semis show their hand first.
